burn-of-the-everflame.explainedBy: Ignas closes the gap and the two hold each other on 'launches herself into the arms': apart -> she reaches him -> embraced.

storyboard.claim: Ignas, sobbing, launches herself into the arms of her long lost mortal mate.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Ignas runs into her mate's arms; they embrace.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The curse broken in 218 lets them meet.
storyboard.addedInformation: The reunion is shown as the embrace itself.

15-secrets-successful-people-know-about-.explainedBy: The designer reaches to the nightstand and, on 'grab their phone', takes the phone into their hand: reach -> grab -> holding it.

storyboard.claim: Still in bed, the designer grabs the phone from the nightstand.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A hand reaches the phone on the stand and brings it in.
storyboard.addedInformation: The phone is taken before they are out of bed.

15-secrets-successful-people-know-about-.explainedBy: The same person still holds the phone they just grabbed; the face drops at 52 unread emails.

storyboard.claim: The notification is 52 unread emails, a punch in the gut.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Same person, the phone still in hand, afraid.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Result of the grab in 74 (kept stage).
